# Vendored UI assets

Pinned to the versions referenced by the original UI:

- Bootstrap 5.3.3: bootstrap.min.css and bootstrap.bundle.min.js.
  Source: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.3/dist
  License: bootstrap/LICENSE (MIT).
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3: CSS and WOFF/WOFF2 fonts.
  Source: https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.11.3/font
  License: bootstrap-icons/LICENSE (MIT).

Downloaded from those tags' raw GitHub files on October 29, 2026. These are
third-party upstream assets; do not edit their minified contents. Source maps
referenced by upstream comments are not packaged; they are not runtime assets.
The application's own styles/scripts live outside this directory.
